headline: Tesla and SpaceX Form Committees to Discuss Possible Merger
summary: Elon Musk announced that special committees have been formed within Tesla and SpaceX to discuss a potential merger.
why: Tesla is a major electric vehicle manufacturer, and SpaceX is a private aerospace manufacturer and space transportation services company.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: A potential merger creates strategic and valuation uncertainties for shareholders of both companies.

why_moved: The announcement of merger talks between two major high-profile companies led by Elon Musk heavily impacts market attention and trading activity.
